title: (To be deprecated)Create Catalog Listing Ads
content_data:
This article introduces how to create Catalog Listing Ads. > **Note**
We are ending our Catalog Listing Ads (CLA) soon and closing out all active CLA campaigns. In the coming months, we will be consolidating CLA with Video Shopping Ads into a unified Shopping Ads solution. We will have more to share on integration opportunities for this new solution in the near future and look forward to introducing new catalog-powered placements and formats to deliver more immediate value for our advertisers. > **Note**
> The flags of `Required`/ `Conditional` in the following parameter tables are only applicable for Catalog Listing Ads. # 1. Create a campaign Create a campaign using [/campaign/create/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1739318962329602). The following table lists the related parameters. > **Note**
> Currently, Campaign Budget Optimization is not supported for Shopping Ads. ```xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |advertiser_id {Required}|string|Advertiser ID | |objective_type {Required}|string| Advertising objective. Use `PRODUCT_SALES` for Shopping Ads. | |budget_mode {+Conditional}|string|How you'd like to set your budget. For example, you can set a daily budget. To learn about how to set budget modes, see [Budget](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1739381246298114).| |budget {+Conditional}|float| Campaign budget. Required when `budget_mode` is `BUDGET_MODE_DAY` or `BUDGET_MODE_TOTAL`. To learn about the minimum budget and how to set budget modes, see [Budget](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1739381246298114). | |campaign_name {Required}|string|Campaign name. It can contain up to 512 characters. Emoji is not supported.
Note: Each word in Chinese or Japanese counts as two characters, while each letter in English counts as one character.| |campaign_type|string|Enums values: `REGULAR_CAMPAIGN`,` IOS14_CAMPAIGN`.
Note: `IOS14_CAMPAIGN` is not supported for Catalog Listing Ads.| ``` # 2. Create and manage catalogs Create and manage catalogs using Catalog APIs or TikTok Business Center. * Catalog APIs: For all catalog APIs, see [here](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1739578477445121). 1. Create a catalog using [/catalog/create/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1740306481704961). 2. Upload products to the catalog using [/catalog/product/file/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1740496787164161) or [/catalog/product/upload/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1740497429681153). 3. Invite members to Business Center and grant the admin permission using [/bc/member/invite/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1739939455765505). You can also choose `advertiser_role` that you want to assign to the members invited. 4. Share a catalog with members and grant the catalog management access using [/bc/asset/assign/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1739438211077121). Make sure to specify `CATALOG` in the `asset_type` field and `ADMIN` in the `catalog_role` field. * TikTok Business Center 1. Create a catalog on TikTok Business Center. For detailed instructions, see [Manage Catalog in Business Center](https://ads.tiktok.com/help/article?aid=10012889) 2. Upload your products to your catalog. 3. Invite a member to your Business Center and grant the admin permission. For detailed instructions, see [Add Users to TikTok Business Center](https://ads.tiktok.com/help/article?aid=12790). 4. Choose the advertiser account to be shared, add members to the account and grant them the admin access. 5. Share a catalog with members and grant the catalog management access. For detailed instructions, see [Manage Catalog in Business Center - Share Catalog with a Member](https://ads.tiktok.com/help/article?aid=10012889). # 3. Create an ad group Create an ad group using [/adgroup/create/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1739499616346114). The following table lists the related parameters. > **Note**
> Automated Creative Optimization is not supported for Shopping Ads.
Catalog Listing Ads is an image-based ads, so all video related fields are not supported. ```xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |promotion_type{+Conditional} |string|Promotion type and you can decide where you'd like to promote your products using this field. You need to specify the field when advertising objective (`objective_type`) for your campaign is NOT set as `REACH`, `VIDEO_VIEWS`, or `ENGAGEMENT`.
For enum values, see [Enumeration - Promotion Type](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737174886619138). | |product_source{Required}|string|Enum values: `UNSET` ,`CATALOG`(Catalog) . Use `CATALOG` for Shopping Ads. | |shopping_ads_type{Required}|string|Shopping ads type. Enum: `UNSET`, `VIDEO`(Video Shopping Ads),`LIVE`(Live Shopping Ads), `CATALOG_LISTING_ADS`(Catalog Listing Ads) . Use `CATALOG_LISTING_ADS` here.| |pixel_id |string|Pixel ID. Only applicable for landing pages. It needs to be passed in with the `optimization_event` field. Use [/pixel/list/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1740858697598978) endpoint to get all Pixel IDs.
If `optimization_goal` is `CONVERT`, `pixel_id` cannot be empty.| |optimization_event|string|Conversion event for the ad group. It is required when the promoted object is an App with tracking urls, or when `pixel_id` is specified. For the supported app and pixel events, see [Conversion events](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1739361474981889). You can use the [/app/optimization_event/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1740859338750977) endpoint to find out the supported events for your app.
Note: Not supported when `pixel_id` is used in Reach, Video View, and Traffic objectives. | |placement_type |string|The placement strategy that decides where your ads will be shown. Use `PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL` for Catalog Listing Ads
Default value: `PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL`.| |placements {Required}|string[]|The apps where you want to deliver your ads. Required when `placement_type` is `PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL`, and optional when `placement_type` is `PLACEMENT_TYPE_AUTOMATIC`. Use `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK` for Catalog Listing Ads. | |auto_targeting_enabled|boolean|Whether to enable automated targeting. Choose `True`.| |schedule_type {Required} |string|The schedule type can be either `SCHEDULE_START_END` or `SCHEDULE_FROM_NOW`. If you choose `SCHEDULE_START_END`, you need to specify a start time and an end time. If you choose `SCHEDULE_FROM_NOW`, you only need to specify a start time. If `budget_mode` is `BUDGET_MODE_TOTAL`, this field must be set to `SCHEDULE_START_END`.| |catalog_id{Required}|string| Catalog ID. | |catalog_authorized_bc_id {Required}|string| Business Center ID that has permission for this catalog. For catalogs in Business Center, you must specify the ID of the Business Center that a catalog belongs to.| |optimization_goal{Required}|string|The measurable results you'd like to drive with your ads. Use `CONVERT` or `CLICK` for Catalog Listing Ads. | |billing_event {Required}|string| Events that you want to pay for. Support `OCPC` and `CPC` for Catalog Listing Ads. If `optimization_goal`= `CLICK`, you have to choose `CPC` for billing event.| |bid_type {Required} |string|Bidding strategy that determines how the system manages your cost per result, spends your budget, and how it delivers ads. Only support `BID_TYPE_CUSTOM` for Catalog Listing Ads. | |conversion_bid_price{+Conditional} |float| Where you can set a target cost per conversion for oCPM(Optimized Cost per Mille); Required when `billing_event` = `OCPM` and `bid_type` = `BID_TYPE_CUSTOM`.| |pacing |string| You can choose between `PACING_MODE_SMOOTH` and `PACING_MODE_FAST`. For `PACING_MODE_SMOOTH`, the budget is allocated evenly within the scheduled time. `PACING_MODE_FAST` would consume budget and produce results as soon as possible. When Campaign Budget Optimization (`budget_optimize_on`) is on, your setting will be ignored and it will be set as `PACING_MODE_SMOOTH`. Otherwise, this field is required. | ``` # 4. Create an ad Create an ad using [/ad/create/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1739953377508354). The following table includes related parameters. > **Note**
> Catalog Listing Ads is an imaged-based ads, so all video related fields are not supported. ```xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |identity_id {Required}|string|Identity ID.| |identity_type {Required}|string| Identity type. Enum: `CUSTOMIZED_USER`, `AUTH_CODE`, `TT_USER`, `BC_AUTH_TT`. Use `CUSTOMIZED_USER` for Shopping Ads.
For details about identities, see [Identities](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1738958351620097).
Note: When `identity_type` = `CUSTOMIZED_USER`, you shouldn't pass any `identity_authorized_bc_id`. | |ad_name {Required}|string| Ad name. | |catalog_id{Required}|string| Catalog ID. | |product_specific_type{Required}|string|Different dimensions to choose products. Enum values: `ALL`,` PRODUCT_SET`, `CUSTOMIZED_PRODUCTS`.
If you choose `ALL`, you don't need to input `sku_ids` or `item_group_ids` or `product_set_id`. `item_group_ids` or `product_set_id` are required if `product_specific_type`=`PRODUCT_SET`. `sku_ids` are required if `product_specific_type`=`CUSTOMIZED_PRODUCTS`| |item_group_ids {+Conditional}|string[]|Product SPU ID. Max size=20.| |product_set_id {+Conditional}|string|The ID of the product set.| |sku_ids {+Conditional}|string|IDs of the SKUs. Max size=20.| ``` # 5. Preview an ad After the ad is created, preview your ad using [/creative/ads_preview/create/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1739403070695426).
We offer preview types of `AD` and `ADS_CREATION` to enable you to preview existing ads and the ads that you haven't created.
